historicalNextResponseBreach.description: At least one recorded next support response breach. A Case is counted once.

firstResponseOutcome.description: Outcome against the original first-response deadline as of generatedAt.

remainingBusinessSeconds.description: Signed business seconds until the active deadline. Historical Cases with no calendar snapshot use elapsed seconds.

remainingMillis.description: Signed remaining duration at observedAt. Before dueAt, support deadlines use snapshotted business time; follow-ups use elapsed time. At or after dueAt, negative values represent elapsed wall-clock lateness, including closed business hours. Historical business-time measurements are unchanged.

businessIntervals.description: Server-resolved UTC business intervals through clockValidUntil for unexpired support countdowns. Null denotes an elapsed follow-up clock. After dueAt, elapsed overdue duration needs no business intervals or calendar-horizon clamp.

botConnectorBearer.description: Microsoft Bot Connector RS256 token pinned to the configured bot audience, issuer, tenant and service URL.
